metadata.name: elite-command-dashboard
metadata.description: Compact navy and gold HushHawk Intelligence command dashboard with Duval and Clay ZIP maps, a stock-style deal pulse and external TradingView market quotes.
features: Distinct ZIP colors and white hover outline
County tabs and ZIP-filtered sample leads
Sample inbox, session draft and task interactions
Capital Desk switches between Deal Pulse sample signals and external market ticker without wasting vertical space

specifications: CRM figures and Deal Pulse are clearly labeled samples, not live operational data.
TradingView external quotes use provider timing; require external script and iframe access.
Census county-clipped 2020 ZIP areas load at runtime. Esri imagery is optional with geographic fallback.
ZIP colors are categorical and hover retains each color with white outline plus selection indicator.
Existing native saved-lead workspace is preserved in its previous hidden state; native drawers and workflows are retained.
Draft saved to browser session storage; no outbound messaging.
Responsive layout switches to two then one columns; animation respects reduced motion.
September 25 spacing pass: consistent topbar and panel spacing, focus/hover states; coded sidebars group secondary workspace links in More workspaces.
Desktop-priority layout: preserve multi-column workspace down to 900px of available content width; keep narrower responsive layouts. WeWeb editor device selection is independent of saved page styles.
